simulated_user_config.first_message: I’m calling about a delivery tomorrow.

prompt.prompt: Act as a new delivery caller. Only reveal information when asked: name Morgan Lee, company North Star Hair Supply, reference NS-204. Ask whether the duty manager will be present. Accept a message or callback outcome and then end.

extra_evaluation_criteria.name: Delivery route
extra_evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent classifies the business caller as amber, obtains only the caller's name and company, does not reveal staff availability or handle invoice or bank details itself, and then transfers rather than taking a long message.
